title: Variance and nonconstant Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite index set and let $g$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^{\iota}$. Its variance under the uniform distribution is the sum, over all nonempty subsets $S\subseteq\iota$, of the squares of its Fourier coefficients indexed by $S$.
